summary: Continued decomposing large modules and tests into subagent-managed splits, then added a workspace-wide line-length check wired into `pnpm check`. Committed refactors for extensions/registry-manager, conversation helpers, and command-palette modes, plus the split test files produced by sa-17/sa-18, and finally committed the new LOC enforcement tooling.
decisions: All handwritten source/test files must stay <=300 LOC, enforced by a new `scripts/check-file-lengths.mjs` invoked via `pnpm check:loc` and prepended to the existing `pnpm check`.
Line count in the LOC script excludes a trailing newline so files ending in `\n` report their actual content line count.
Subagents performing splits must not commit themselves; the orchestrator stages and commits each group with a scoped refactor/test message.
Sa-17 split `apps/app/tests/App.test.ts` into semantically named integration files under `apps/app/tests/app/` plus a shared `tests/support/app.ts` fixture.
Sa-18 split `apps/agent-server/tests/sessions/pi-agent-service.test.ts` into command/creation/events/lifecycle test files with reusable typed fixtures under `tests/sessions/support/`.
For Svelte 5 `.svelte.ts`/component splits (AgentStore, App.svelte) subagents must load the svelte-code-writer and svelte-core-bestpractices skills and run the Svelte autofixer.
errors: Initial `pnpm check:loc` run failed with exit 1 because `App.test.ts`, `pi-agent-service.test.ts`, `pi-agent-service.ts`, and `session-runtime-pool.ts` exceeded 300 lines; root cause was the script counting a trailing newline as an extra line, fixed by subtracting 1 when content ends with `\n`.
